settings.headline: Looks like a leather brief, heats like a kitchen stove
settings.body: Most colleagues didn’t even realize it was an electric tiffin until I plugged the white cord into my desk socket. Twenty-five minutes later my dal, sabzi, and rice are genuinely steaming hot.
settings.author: Rohan Deshmukh

settings.headline: Zero spills in transit and easy wipe-clean inside
settings.body: I carry the Black Carryo Large on 12-hour hospital duties. The textured leatherette looks sharp and the stainless steel containers keep rasam and rice hot without needing a microwave.
settings.author: Dr. Meera Krishnan
settings.role: Emergency Medicine Resident, Apollo Hospitals, Chennai

settings.headline: Compact outside, surprisingly spacious inside
settings.body: I picked the Small box in Grey for lighter office days. It easily holds two full steel bowls and feels worlds apart from clunky plastic electric lunchboxes.
settings.author: Ananya Verma
